name: Fino
aging: Aged under a protective layer of flor yeast in Jerez de la Frontera or El Puerto de Santa María, each town contributing its own characteristic microclimate.
description: Fresh, crisp, and slightly salty. The driest and lightest style of sherry, protected during aging by a layer of flor yeast.

name: Manzanilla
aging: Aged under flor exclusively in Sanlúcar de Barrameda, a coastal town whose humid Atlantic microclimate keeps the flor thicker year-round, producing an even lighter and saltier wine.
description: A coastal style of Fino from Sanlúcar de Barrameda. Even lighter and more delicate, with a noticeable salty, sea-air character from the humid Atlantic climate.

name: Amontillado
aging: Undergoes two phases: biological ageing under flor as a Fino or Manzanilla, then transitions to oxidative ageing after the flor dies, developing its characteristic nutty depth.
description: Begins as Fino but is aged with oxygen after the flor dies. Medium-bodied with a nutty, slightly deeper flavor profile.

name: Oloroso
aging: The ultimate expression of oxidative ageing — no flor protection from the start. All flavors and aromas develop through direct contact with air and the oak of the barrels.
description: Aged fully with oxygen from the start — no flor protection. Full-bodied and rich, with a darker color and pronounced notes of nuts and warm spice.

name: East India Sherry
aging: Created by 'cabeceo' — the traditional practice of blending aged dry sherry wines with sweet sherry wines, inspired by wines that were once aged on long sea voyages.
description: Inspired by wines aged on long sea voyages. Usually a blend, often including Pedro Ximénez. Smooth and rich with flavors of caramel and dried fruit.

name: Pedro Ximénez
aging: Pedro Ximénez grapes are spread in the sun after harvest until they are nearly raisins, concentrating their sugars. The resulting must is then fermented and aged oxidatively.
description: The quintessential dessert sherry. Made entirely from sun-dried Pedro Ximénez grapes, it is opulently sweet and dark, with flavors of raisins, figs, molasses, and chocolate.
